deadline.value: January 15 (applications for Fall 2027 open October 1, 2026). Year inferred.
deadline.quote: The application is due on Jan 15 for the incoming class of the year. | We will begin accepting applications for the Fall 2027 academic year starting on October 1, 2026.

gre_subject.value: The Physics GRE is optional; submit it if you have it, but it is one of many inputs.
gre_subject.quote: Both GRE general and GRE physics are optional.

supervisor.value: Admission is by committee; applicants only list up to 3 faculty of interest, and students move into a research group after starting.
supervisor.quote: As they transition to a group, research advisors and their group members join the mentoring team.

also.quote: The names of up to 3 Graduate Faculty from our department with whom you are interested in working and up to 3 subfields of your interest.

funding.value: Every admitted PhD student is offered tuition and stipend support (TA first, later RA) for the duration of the degree, subject to satisfactory progress.
funding.quote: Every student admitted to our department is offered financial support, usually in the form of a teaching assistantship at first | Students will receive financial support (tuition and stipend), through fellowships, teaching assistantships, or research assistantships, for the duration of the degree, contingent on satisfactory progress toward their degree.

also.quote: All students accepted for graduate study in the doctoral program are offered financial assistance, generally in the form of a teaching assistantship that cover both tuition and a graduate stipend.

entry_route.value: A bachelor's degree in physics or an allied field is enough for the PhD; a master's is not required.
entry_route.quote: A bachelor's degree in physics or an allied field is required for admission to the M.S., and Ph.D. programs.

app_fee.value: Fee waived for ALL applicants this year: enter code PHYS2027
app_fee.quote: To ensure access to all qualified applicants, the Physics PhD program is waiving the fee for ALL applicants this year. There is no cost to apply. Please enter the waiver code PHYS2027 in your application.

fee_waiver.value: Automatic for everyone this cycle via code PHYS2027 (international included)
fee_waiver.quote: the Physics PhD program is waiving the fee for ALL applicants this year.

gre_general.value: The General GRE is optional for physics applicants.
gre_general.quote: Both GRE general and GRE physics are optional.

ielts_min.value: Physics department states a minimum composite IELTS score of 6.5.
ielts_min.quote: As for the IELTS, the minimum composite score is 6.5.

notes: Free to apply this cycle; a low-cost 'safety-to-target' add for many lists. Department FAQ still quotes TOEFL iBT 80 (old scale), so no department TOEFL value is set; the university record applies.
